title: E-CSM-0050: a 3D object (a boundary patch) subtends a bulk cone whose apex depth is the boundary depth minus...
purpose: Experiment E-CSM-0050 in the cosmology arena: a 3D object (a boundary patch) subtends a bulk cone whose apex depth is the boundary depth minus log(object size), so bigger objects have deeper apexes, nested objects give nested cones, and separation tracks the shared apex depth.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
